description: Vehicles: prepare (unsigned) the purchase of a vehicle (model 1 Sentinel, 2 Hauler, 3 Courier, 4 Helicopter, 5 Private jet) for ZENI: an approve for the exact price, then buy. Needs the public sale open (see vehicle_shop). Aircraft (helicopter, jet) can be bought and stolen but can never race (the Night Run takes only a Sentinel or a Courier), and the heist does not check any licence. The Air licence only matters for insuring an aircraft, and insurance is switched off.

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.

name: prepare_vehicle_buy
